page.title: Holders
page.purpose: Let the minter manage who participates in the economy and see each holder's position without ever weakening the boundary between them.

priorities.statement: Each holder's spendable and reserved balance is visible at a glance.
Adding a holder makes the link to their authenticated identity explicit.
priorities.notes: A holder without a real identity is a role flag, and the isolation boundary would be cosmetic.

priorities.statement: Removing a holder is presented as a tombstone, because their events must remain readable.

states.description: No holders yet; the page explains that an economy needs at least one.
